## Issue template (OpsHalo)

Please describe:

1. **OpsHalo version / commit** (or `package.json` version)
2. **OS** (Windows / macOS / Linux)
3. **Steps to reproduce**
4. **Expected vs actual**
5. Whether it is related to **SSH / SFTP / AI Smart Shell / themes / settings**

> Features such as Telnet / Serial / RDP / VNC / Spice are **out of Mini scope**. For the full client, open an issue on upstream electerm: https://github.com/bowie-xz8090/OpsHalo/issues/new/choose
